correctness.rationale: Check exact L1 dual L-infinity vector representation and moments E(g_i r_j)=delta_ij; trace Holder yields lower n^(1/p), attained by r. At p>1 strict Holder equality forces g=r; at p=infty n coordinate constraints force r_jg_j=1. For p=1, explicit epsilon perturbation g1=r1+epsilon,g2=r2-epsilon r1r2 has norm n and all moments. Reconstruct sharp Khintchine/Jensen and p-interpolation for p>=2, permutation symmetrization for p=1, correct p in (1,2) lower bound; Hilbert identity is exactly E||g-r||²=E||g||²-n, sharp via r_{n+1}(r2,-r1). Independent enumeration n=2..9 verifies binomial, perturbation norms and moments; no assertion of exact ||Q|| for 1<p<2.

Exact ||Q|| for p=1 and p>=2; for 1<p<2 only bound. Sharp p=2 stability identity and equality for every C>=sqrt(n).
